title: I used Claude Code to get a second opinion on my MRI
summary: A developer used Claude Code (with Claude Opus) to analyze their MRI scan results as a second opinion, demonstrating how AI can assist in understanding personal medical imaging. The author shared their workflow and findings on a personal blog, sparking significant discussion about AI's potential in healthcare.
problem_solved: Helps individuals better understand complex medical imaging results by using AI to interpret and explain scan findings.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a practical real-world application of AI beyond coding—showing how LLMs can democratize access to medical understanding and provide accessible second opinions on health data.
